scope: two diagnostics; no new fusion model or survival-selected retrieval
primary_schedule: fixed lambda=1 Efron Ridge Cox; all features fit-standardized
sensitivity_schedule: same inner split, lambda grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,OFF], ties prefer OFF then larger lambda
determinism: no random model parameters; identical five patient folds across seeds; fit once per fold then explicit deterministic references for other seeds
secondary_endpoint: PFI frozen DSS risk transfer, not PFI-specific fitting
query_scope: cached ROI overlap on heldout patients for all3seeds; new embedding/rank audit seed31 only; 32 fixed morphology concepts unchanged
counterfactual: six outcome-blind random heldout patients per fold=30; each of8 RNA states individually forced low/high with clinical and other seven states fixed; stress test, not causal patient intervention
numerical_control: same text independently reencoded as32-text batch for the30 selected patients; report query and ROI drift
spatial_metrics: intersection fraction, Jaccard,8x8 histogram total variation, centroid distance and symmetric nearest-neighbor distance normalized by WSI candidate bounding-box diagonal
morphology_scope: independent patient HISTOLOGICAL_DIAGNOSIS only for supplementary mucinous association; no patch truth; raw-image QA remains blocked until images available
privacy: patient rows, coordinates, images, text embeddings, OOF and model states private; public fold/group aggregates only
interpretation: within-cohort exploratory diagnostics; no global no-go or information-theoretic claims
